content.description:
Lend7 is a platform for tokenising real estate assets, allowing an NFT token holder to buy and retain ownership rights and protections provided by traditional real estate ownership.

Our main goal of the project is to decentralise the real estate market, making big business available for small investors — all with the help of blockchain technology.
